title: Fajita Spice Mix
description: A pantry-staple blend of chilli powder, smoked paprika, cumin and oregano for seasoning fajitas and other Mexican-inspired dishes.
steps: Combine all ingredients; store in a jam jar or airtight container.
notes: Use in Flaming Fajita Traybake (p.88) and Slow-cooker Mexican Beef (p.180).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
